xml.brief: Change the listing of an own geocache

desc.p: The owner changes the listing of their geocache. Only the parameters given are changed; a value equal to the stored one changes nothing, so a client may send back all fields it has read.
This method does not change the status (use services/caches/archive, disable and enable).
This method is only available on installations that support cache editing. Check the has_cache_editing field in services/apisrv/installation before calling it.

req.name: cache_code
req.p: Code of the geocache. The user must be its owner.

opt.name: cache_name
opt.p: New name. Must not be empty.

opt.name: latitude
opt.p: New latitude. Must be given together with longitude.

opt.name: longitude
opt.p: New longitude. Must be given together with latitude. 0|0 is refused.

opt.name: passwd
opt.p: New log password; an empty value removes it. The same rules as in services/caches/edit, which stays available for clients that use it.

opt.name: desc_lang
opt.p: Which description short_description, description and hint2 change. The geocache must already have a description in this language.

opt.name: short_description
opt.p: New short description, plain text only. An empty value removes it.

opt.name: description
opt.p: New description, plain text, as in services/caches/create.

Only a description without formatting can be replaced: one whose only HTML tags are

,

and
(without attributes). That includes every description written through OKAPI, and descriptions written on the website as a few paragraphs of text. To show such a description for editing, a client turns it into plain text: paragraphs into blank lines, line breaks into line breaks, character references into characters. The new text replaces it in the plain form OKAPI writes.

A description with more formatting (links, images, bold text, lists and so on) is refused with HTTP 400 and stays unchanged, so that no client removes the formatting; the owner changes it on the website. The other parameters are not affected by this.
These methods are meant for simple listings, such as an app creates in the field, and their later corrections. They are not a full listing editor; that is the website.

opt.name: hint2
opt.p: New hint, plain text only. An empty value removes it.

opt.name: alt_wpts
opt.p: Replaces all additional waypoints of the geocache with this JSON array (format as in services/caches/create). An empty array removes all of them. Cannot be combined with add_alt_wpts or remove_alt_wpts.
As in services/caches/create, additional waypoints are public: on OCDE everyone sees them with their coordinates, so a final waypoint gives the final location away.

opt.name: add_alt_wpts
opt.p: JSON array of waypoints to add, in the same format. The existing ones stay.

opt.name: remove_alt_wpts
opt.p: Pipe-separated names of waypoints to remove, as returned in the alt_wpts field of services/caches/geocache (e.g. "OC1234-1|OC1234-3"). The names refer to the waypoints as they were before this call; the names of the remaining waypoints may change afterwards. An unknown name is refused and nothing is changed.

returns.p: A dictionary with changed, the list of parameters whose value was different from the stored one and was saved (alt_wpts stands for any waypoint change). An empty list means nothing was changed.
